data: What is the approximate value of the blue line at 40 annotators?

The blue line represents interannotator agreement for sarcasm trigrams. The x-axis shows the number of annotators, ranging from 0 to 45. The y-axis represents Pearson's correlation coefficient, ranging from 0 to 1.2. At approximately 40 annotators, the blue line appears to be around 0.95.
